name: id
doc: Unicode code point of the character. A later QuadChar or Char with the same id replaces this one

name: rect_x
doc: Left edge of the glyph in the Texture, in pixels

name: rect_y
doc: Top edge of the glyph in the Texture, in pixels

name: rect_w
doc: Width of the glyph in the Texture, in pixels. Also used as the advance (width) for a new glyph

name: rect_h
doc: Height of the glyph in the Texture, in pixels
